headline: Law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs carry out certain major medical facility projects in 2023 and caps spending on each.
what_it_does: This law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) permission to carry out specific major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2023. It also sets the most money that can be spent on each project. The official summary does not list which projects or locations are included.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who get care at VA medical facilities
who_it_affects.how: The approved construction or improvement projects could change the VA facilities where they receive care.
The VA is allowed to move forward with the listed projects but must stay within the spending limit set for each one.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted July 18, 2023; applies to projects during fiscal year 2023.
